supersedes_candidate_determinations.reason: The original determination relied on the 2020 Form 10-K and did not incorporate a material pre-event November 4, 2021 issuer disclosure establishing a second active therapeutic asset before the December 2021 event.

rows.evidence_summary: On November 4, 2021, more than one month before the candidate event, Imara publicly described IMR-261 as a new asset in its development pipeline, stated that it was a clinic-ready oral Nrf2 activator, and stated that drug-product manufacturing work had been initiated while clinical development paths were being explored. The same disclosure continued development of tovinontrine/IMR-687. Thus the issuer had at least two distinct meaningful active therapeutic assets at the event date under the conservative frozen single-asset definition. The later 2021 Form 10-K independently confirms that Imara was advancing both tovinontrine and IMR-261.

conference_availability_note.finding: The candidate's December 13, 2021 issuer release is not automatically the earliest material public availability. Imara announced on November 4 that accepted ASH abstracts were already available online, and Blood bibliographic metadata dates abstract 2046 to November 5, 2021. If this event remains in the wider non-single-asset cohort reserve, its conference first-public availability must be normalized separately before promotion.
